purpose: Teach: 与野党/惨敗/屈折/コレステロール/ステロイド/草の根/転向/撃つ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療政策、本気で、絶対、与野党、絶対、合意が、絶対、必要、絶対、ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, medical policy really does require consensus across both parties, doesn't it? I'm grateful for your perspective.
lines.style: Steady, measured cadence. Clinical precision in phrasing. Direct eye contact level. Warm but professional—the doctor speaking to a thoughtful student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 臨床試験、本気で、絶対、惨敗、絶対、した、絶対、新薬、絶対、ありましたよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: There was that clinical trial—the one where the new drug failed so badly, wasn't there, sensei? I appreciate how you handled it.
lines.style: Tentative, searching. Building thought mid-sentence. Slight pause before 「先生」—checking whether he's remembering correctly. Respectful curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。視力の、本気で、絶対、屈折、絶対、検査、絶対、最新機器、絶対、導入しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've introduced the latest equipment for vision and refraction testing. I'm glad we could invest in that care.
lines.style: Clear, informative. Each phrase lands with quiet conviction. Slight emphasis on 「最新」—professional pride without showiness. Breath steady, posture upright.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんの、本気で、絶対、コレステロール、絶対、値、絶対、改善、絶対、目指しているんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: You're really focused on helping your patients bring their cholesterol levels down, aren't you, sensei?
lines.style: Dawning recognition. Soft, genuine interest. Not confirming—discovering aloud. Slight lean in, as if understanding something newly about her priorities.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。重症患者、本気で、絶対、ステロイド、絶対、慎重に、絶対、処方、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. With serious cases, I'm always cautious about steroid dosing. That's where the real judgment call lies.
lines.style: Slower. Weight on 「慎重に」. The voice of someone who has sat with difficult decisions. Quiet gravity—not alarming, just honest about the stakes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 草の根、本気で、絶対、健康教室、絶対、医療チームで、絶対、続けられているんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: You've kept those grassroots health classes going with your whole team, haven't you? That's what stays with people.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Slowing toward the end, as if watching something take shape. Small smile in the voice. The tone of someone recognizing quiet persistence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの食生活、本気で、絶対、転向、絶対、進めていただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're helping patients shift their eating habits—it's slow, but it's the real work.
lines.style: Patient, almost tender. 「食生活」 given time to settle. Rhythm unhurried. The voice of someone who measures success not in appointments but in small, sustained changes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急の現場で、本気で、絶対、麻酔銃を、絶対、撃つ、絶対、ような、絶対、特殊な、絶対、事例、絶対、聞いたことありますね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Have you ever dealt with anything like those rare emergency situations—the kind where you'd need something as unusual as a tranquilizer gun?
lines.style: Hesitant awe. Building the image carefully, almost disbelievingly. Trailing slightly upward on the question. The sound of someone asking something he's half-nervous about asking, drawn in by genuine curiosity.
